name: Fursang
description: Fursang was a Hungarian furry event held in late January or early February in Budapest from 2015 to 2020, organized by F Terminal. It began in 2015 as a fursuit walk through the streets of Budapest and grew each year, and in 2020 it became a full furry convention at the Bara Hotel, the first in Hungary. The name is a pun on the Hungarian word for carnival, "farsang". Both the website and live events were translated into English. A seventh edition planned for 2021 was repeatedly postponed and then cancelled, and the organizers shifted their focus to their other Hungarian event, Örli Försztivál.
